verses.geez: ኦ፡ እግዚኦ፡ መፍቀሬ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስመ፡ እንቲአከ፡ ይእቲ፡ ጥበብ፡ እስመ፡ ዘኢይጠፍእ፡ መንፈስከ፡ ኄር፡ ሀሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ።
verses.translation: For thine incorruptible Spirit is in all things.

translations.lxx: For thine incorruptible Spirit is in all things.
translations.ron: Duhul Tău cel fără stricăciune este întru toate.
translations.grk: Τὸ γὰρ ἄφθαρτόν σου πνεῦμά ἐστιν ἐν πᾶσι.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ትዘልፍ፡ ለእለ፡ ወድቁ፡ በዘሕቅ፡ ዘከመ፡ ይደሉ፡ ለንባብ፡ ወአበሳ፡ እንተ፡ አበሱ፡ እንዘ፡ ታዜክሮሙ፡ ወትጌሥፆሙ፡ ከመ፡ ሶበ፡ ይጤይቁ፡ ርኂቆሙ፡ እምእከዮሙ፡ ይእመኑ፡ ብከ፡ እግዚኦ።
verses.translation: Therefore chastenest thou them by little and little that offend, and warnest them by putting them in remembrance wherein they have offended, that leaving their wickedness they may believe on thee, O Lord.

translations.lxx: Therefore chastenest thou them by little and little that offend, and warnest them by putting them in remembrance wherein they have offended, that leaving their wickedness they may believe on thee, O Lord.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea pedepseşti cu măsură pe cei care cad şi, când păcătuiesc, le deschizi ochii şi-i dojeneşti, ca să se lase de răutatea lor şi să creadă întru Tine, Doamne.
translations.grk: Διὸ τοὺς παραπίπτοντας κατʼ ὀλίγον ἐλέγχεις, καὶ ἐν οἷς ἁμαρτάνουσιν ὑπομιμνήσκων νουθετεῖς, ἵνα ἀπαλλαγέντες τῆς κακίας πιστεύσωσιν ἐπὶ σὲ Κύριε.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ለቀደምት፡ እለ፡ የኀድሩ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድርከ፡ ቅድስት፡ ጸላእከ፡ በእንተ፡ ምግባራቲሆሙ፡ ግብረ፡ ሥራይ፡ ጽሉእ፡ ወበዓላቲሆሙኒ፡ ዘርኁቅ፡ እምጽድቅ።
verses.translation: For it was thy will to destroy by the hands of our fathers both those old inhabitants of thy holy land,

translations.lxx: For it was thy will to destroy by the hands of our fathers both those old inhabitants of thy holy land,
translations.ron: De locuitorii cei de demult ai sfântului Tău pământ Te-ai scârbit,
translations.grk: Καὶ γὰρ τοὺς παλαιοὺς οἰκήτορας τῆς ἁγίας σου γῆς

verses.geez: ወቅትለተ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ምሕረት፡ ወአስተበውሖቶሙሰ፡ በሊዐ፡ ንዋየ፡ ውሥጠ፡ ከርሦሙ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ወሥጋሆሙ፡ ወደሞሙ።
verses.translation: whom thou hatedst for doing most odious works of witchcrafts, and wicked sacrifices;

translations.lxx: whom thou hatedst for doing most odious works of witchcrafts, and wicked sacrifices;
translations.ron: Căci făceau lucruri nelegiuite, vrăjitoreşti şi aduceau jertfe necurate,
translations.grk: μισήσας, ἐπὶ τῷ ἔχθιστα πράσσειν ἔργα φαρμακειῶν, καὶ τελετὰς ἀνοσίους,

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ተአተተ፡ እማእከሎሙ፡ አእምሮ፡ ምሥጢራተ፡ መለኮትከ፡ ወለነፍስ፡ እንተ፡ አልባቲ፡ ረድኤት፡ እምኀበ፡ መኑሂ፡ ይቀትሉ፡ ነፍሳቲሆሙ፡ ፈቀድከ፡ ታኅጒሎሙ፡ በእደ፡ አበዊነ፡ ከመ፡ ይንሥኡ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ምኅደረ፡ ዘይደሉ፡ ሎሙ፡ እንተ፡ እምኀቤከ፡ ክብርት፡ እምኵሉ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: and also those merciless murderers of children, and devourers of man's flesh, and the feasts of blood,

translations.lxx: and also those merciless murderers of children, and devourers of man's flesh, and the feasts of blood,
translations.ron: Omorând fără milă pe prunci, mâncând carne omenească şi adăpându-se cu sânge; pe aceşti jertfitori spurcaţi
translations.grk: τέκνων τε φονέας ἀνελεήμονας, καὶ σπλαγχνοφάγων ἀνθρωπίνων σαρκῶν θοῖναν,

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ኪያሆሙኒ፡ መሐርከ፡ ዘከመ፡ ትምሕር፡ ሰብአ፡ ወሶበ፡ ፈኖከ፡ መራደ፡ ትንንያ፡ ይቅድሙ፡ ተዓይኒከ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ በበሕቅ፡ ይሥርዉ።
verses.translation: with their priests out of the midst of their idolatrous crew, and the parents, that killed with their own hands souls destitute of help:

translations.lxx: with their priests out of the midst of their idolatrous crew, and the parents, that killed with their own hands souls destitute of help:
translations.ron: Şi părinţi ucigaşi ai unor prunci fără de apărare ai voit să-i nimiceşti prin mâinile părinţilor noştri,
translations.grk: καὶ αἴματος ἐκ μέσου μυσταθείας σου, καὶ αὐθέντας γονεῖς ψυχῶν ἀβοηθήτων, ἐβουλήθης ἀπολέσαι διὰ χειρῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν·

verses.geez: ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ እምኢተስእነከ፡ ከመ፡ ታግብኦሙ፡ ለረዓሲን፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሆሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ በበዖታሆሙ፡ ይፄውውዎሙ።
verses.translation: that the land, which thou esteemedst above all other, might receive a worthy colony of God's children.

translations.lxx: that the land, which thou esteemedst above all other, might receive a worthy colony of God's children.
translations.ron: Aşa încât acest pământ, care este mai de cinste înaintea Ta decât toate celelalte, să primească - vrednici locuitori - pe fiii lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: ἵνα ἀξίαν ἀποικίαν δέξηται Θεοῦ παίδων ἡ παρὰ σοὶ πασῶν τιμιωτάτη γῆ.

verses.geez: ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ ትመጥዎሙ፡ ለአራዊት፡ ጸዋጋን፡ ወእመ፡ አኮ፡ በእሉኒ፡ በአሐዱ፡ ቃል፡ አዚዘከ፡ ታጥፍኦሙ።
verses.translation: Nevertheless even those thou sparedst as men, and didst send wasps, forerunners of thine host, to destroy them by little and little.

translations.lxx: Nevertheless even those thou sparedst as men, and didst send wasps, forerunners of thine host, to destroy them by little and little.
translations.ron: Dar şi pe aceia ca pe nişte oameni i-ai iertat şi le-ai trimis, ca soli ai oştirii Tale pedepsitoare, tăuni care înţeapă, ca să-i ucidă cu încetul.
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ καὶ τούτων ὡς ἀνθρώπων ἐφείσω, ἀπέστειλάς τε προδρόμους τοῦ στρατοπέδου σου σφῆκας, ἵνα αὐτοὺς καταβραχὺ ἐξολοθρεύσωσιν.

verses.geez: ፈታሕከ፡ ይኩን፡ ዝንቱ፡ በበሕቅ፡ እንዘ፡ ትሁብ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ መካን፡ ለንስሐ፡ አኮ፡ ኢያእሚረከ፡ ከመ፡ እኩይ፡ ሀልዎቶሙ፡ ወእከዮሙ፡ ጥቀ፡ ፈድፋደ።
verses.translation: Not that thou wast unable to bring the ungodly under the hand of the righteous in battle, or to destroy them at once with cruel beasts, or with one rough word:

translations.lxx: Not that thou wast unable to bring the ungodly under the hand of the righteous in battle, or to destroy them at once with cruel beasts, or with one rough word:
translations.ron: Nu pentru că n-ai fi putut supune cu război pe cei necredincioşi celor drepţi, sau să-i pierzi dintr-odată cu groaznice fiare, sau cu o poruncă scurtă,
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἀδυνατῶν ἐν παρατάξει ἀσεβεῖς δικαίοις ὑποχειρίους δοῦναι, ἢ θηρίοις δεινοῖς, ἢ λόγῳ ἀποτόμῳ ὑφʼ ἓν ἐκτρίψαι·

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ኢይትመየጥ፡ ሕሊናሆሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ እስመ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ዘርእ፡ ርጉም፡ እምትካት፡ ወአኮ፡ ኀፊረከ፡ መነሂ፡ ለአበሳ፡ ዘአበሱ፡ ትሁቦሙ፡ ዕድሜ።
verses.translation: but executing thy judgments upon them by little and little, thou gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.

translations.lxx: but executing thy judgments upon them by little and little, thou gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.
translations.ron: Ci ai judecat să-i iei cu încetul dându-le loc de pocăinţă, deşi bine ştiai că neamul lor este viclean şi răutatea lor este firească şi răsădită înlăuntru şi că gândul lor nu se va schimba în veac,
translations.grk: κρίνων δὲ καταβραχὺ ἐδίδους τόπον μετανοίας, οὐκ ἀγνοῶν, ὅτι πονηρὰ ἡ γένεσις αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔμφυτος ἡ κακία αὐτῶν, καὶ ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἀλλαγῇ ὁ λογισμὸς αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይብለከ፡ ምንተ፡ ገበርከ፡ ወመኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይትቃሞ፡ ለኵነኔከ፡ ወመኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘያስተዋድከ፡ ወይትኃሠሠከ፡ በእንተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ዘተኀጒሉ፡ ዘአንተ፡ ገበርከ።
verses.translation: For it was a cursed seed from the beginning; neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon for those things wherein they sinned.

translations.lxx: For it was a cursed seed from the beginning; neither didst thou for fear of any man give them pardon for those things wherein they sinned.
translations.ron: Pentru că din început a fost sămânţă blestemată. Apoi nici pentru aceea că Te-ai teme de cineva, Te-ai arătat îndelung-răbdător cu păcatele lor.
translations.grk: σπέρμα γὰρ ἦν κατηραμένον ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· οὐδὲ εὐλαβούμενός τινα, ἐφʼ οἷς ἡμάρτανον ἄδειαν ἐδίδους.

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ መኰንን፡ ዘይበጽሕ፡ ኀቤከ፡ ለተዋቅሦ፡ በእንተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዓማዕያን፡ እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ ባዕድ፡ አምላክ፡ ዘእንበሌከ፡ ዘይሔሊ፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ከመ፡ ታርኢ፡ ከመ፡ አኮ፡ ግፍዐ፡ ዘኰነንከ።
verses.translation: For who shall say, What hast thou done? or who shall withstand thy judgment? or who shall accuse thee for the nations that perish, whom thou hast made? or who shall come to stand against thee, to be revenged for the unrighteous men?

translations.lxx: For who shall say, What hast thou done? or who shall withstand thy judgment? or who shall accuse thee for the nations that perish, whom thou hast made? or who shall come to stand against thee, to be revenged for the unrighteous men?
translations.ron: Căci cine ar putea să-ţi zică: Ce-ai făcut? Sau cine va sta împotriva judecăţii Tale? Sau cine Te va scoate vinovat pentru neamurile cele nimicite, pe care Tu însuţi le-ai făcut? Sau cine se va ridica asupra Ta cu judecată pentru oamenii cei nedrepţi?
translations.grk: Τίς γὰρ ἐρεῖ, τί ἐποίησας; ἢ τίς ἀντιστήσεται τῷ κρίματί σου; τίς δὲ ἐγκαλέσει σοι κατὰ ἐθνῶν ἀπολωλότων, ἃ σὺ ἐποίησας; ἢ τίς εἰς κατάστασίν σοι ἐλεύσεται ἔκδικος κατὰ ἀδίκων ἀνθρώπων;

verses.geez: ኢ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ወኢ፡ መኰንን፡ ወኢ፡ መስፍን፡ ኢይክል፡ ተናጽሮ፡ ምስሌከ፡ እንዘ፡ ይሔምየከ፡ በእንተ፡ እለ፡ ኰነንኮሙ።
verses.translation: For neither is there any God but thou that careth for all, to whom thou mightest shew that thy judgment is not unright.

translations.lxx: For neither is there any God but thou that careth for all, to whom thou mightest shew that thy judgment is not unright.
translations.ron: Că nu este alt dumnezeu afară de Tine, care să aibă grijă de toate şi căruia să-i dovedeşti că judecăţile Tale sunt totdeauna drepte.
translations.grk: Οὔτε γὰρ Θεός ἐστι πλὴν σοῦ, ᾧ μέλει περὶ πάντων, ἵνα δείξῃς ὅτι οὐκ ἀδίκως ἔκρινας.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ጻድቅ፡ አንተ፡ ዘበጽድቅ፡ ትሠርዕ፡ ኵሎ፡ ረሰይከ፡ ግብረ፡ ነኪረ፡ እምነ፡ ኃይልከ፡ ዘኢኮነ፡ መፍትወ፡ ለኰንኖ፡ ከመ፡ ትኰንን።
verses.translation: Neither shall king or tyrant be able to set his face against thee for any whom thou hast punished.

translations.lxx: Neither shall king or tyrant be able to set his face against thee for any whom thou hast punished.
translations.ron: Nu este nici împărat, nici stăpânitor care să poată să ridice ochii în faţa Ta şi să-ţi ceară socoteală pentru cei pe care i-ai nimicit.
translations.grk: Οὔτε βασιλεὺς ἢ τύραννος ἀντοφθαλμῆσαι δυνήσεταί σοι περὶ ὧν ἀπώλεσας.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኃይልከ፡ ቀዳሚሃ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ እስመ፡ ቅንየትከ፡ ወምልክናከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ይሬስየከ፡ ትሣሃል፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ።
verses.translation: Forsomuch then as thou art righteous thyself, thou orderest all things righteously: thinking it not agreeable with thy power to condemn him that hath not deserved to be punished.

translations.lxx: Forsomuch then as thou art righteous thyself, thou orderest all things righteously: thinking it not agreeable with thy power to condemn him that hath not deserved to be punished.
translations.ron: Ci, fiind drept, toate le cârmuieşti cu dreptate şi socoteşti lucru nepotrivit cu puterea Ta ca să osândeşti pe cel care nu trebuie pedepsit.
translations.grk: Δίκαιος δὲ ὢν δικαίως τὰ πάντα διέπεις, αὐτὸν τὸν μὴ ὀφείλοντα κολασθῆναι καταδικάσαι ἀλλότριαν ἡγούμενος τῆς σῆς δυνάμεως.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ከሠትከ፡ ኃይለከ፡ ለዘኢየአምን፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ክሂሎትከ፡ ወለእለ፡ ኢየአምኑ፡ ትዘልፍ፡ ተሀብሎቶሙ።
verses.translation: For thy power is the beginning of righteousness, and because thou art the Lord of all, it maketh thee to be gracious unto all.

translations.lxx: For thy power is the beginning of righteousness, and because thou art the Lord of all, it maketh thee to be gracious unto all.
translations.ron: Puterea Ta este începutul dreptăţii şi, pentru că eşti Stăpân a toate, către toţi cu îngăduinţă Te arăţi.
translations.grk: Ἡ γὰρ ἰσχύς σου δικαιοσύνης ἀρχὴ, καὶ τὸ πάντων σε δεσπόζειν, πάντων φείδεσθαι ποιεῖ.

verses.geez: ወእንዘ፡ አንተ፡ መኰንን፡ ኃያል፡ ዘበየዋሃት፡ ትኴንን፡ ወምስለ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ምሕረት፡ ታሄልወነ፡ ወማእዜ፡ እመ፡ ፈቀድከ፡ እስመ፡ ክሂል፡ ሀሎ፡ ኀቤከ።
verses.translation: For when men will not believe that thou art of a full power, thou shewest thy strength, and among them that know it thou makest their boldness manifest.

translations.lxx: For when men will not believe that thou art of a full power, thou shewest thy strength, and among them that know it thou makest their boldness manifest.
translations.ron: Arăţi tăria Ta celor care nu cred în atotputernicia Ta şi înfrângi cutezanţa celor care o cunosc.
translations.grk: Ἰσχὺν γὰρ ἐνδείκνυσαι ἀπιστούμενος ἐπὶ δυνάμεως τελειότητι, καὶ ἐν τοῖς εἰδόσι τὸ θράσος ἐξελέγχεις.

verses.geez: ወመሐርከ፡ ሕዝበከ፡ በዘከመዝ፡ ምግባር፡ ከመ፡ መፍትው፡ ይኩን፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወርኅሩኅ፡ ወመፍቀሬ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: But thou, mastering thy power, judgest with equity, and orderest us with great favour: for thou mayest use power when thou wilt.

translations.lxx: But thou, mastering thy power, judgest with equity, and orderest us with great favour: for thou mayest use power when thou wilt.
translations.ron: Stăpân al puterii cum eşti, judeci cu blândeţe şi ne cârmuieşti cu multă cruţare, că la Tine este puterea, când voieşti.
translations.grk: Σὺ δὲ δεσπόζεν ἰσχύος ἐν ἐπιεικείᾳ κρίνεις καὶ μετὰ πολλῆς φειδοῦς διοικεῖς ἡμᾶς· πάρεστι γάρ σοι ὅταν θέλῃς τὸ δύνασθαι.

verses.geez: ወሠናየ፡ ተስፋ፡ ረሰይከ፡ ለወልድከ፡ ወተናገርኮሙ፡ ለውሉድከ፡ እስመ፡ አንተ፡ ትሁብ፡ ለአባሲ፡ ንስሐ።
verses.translation: But by such works hast thou taught thy people that the just man should be merciful, and hast made thy children to be of a good hope that thou givest repentance for sins.

translations.lxx: But by such works hast thou taught thy people that the just man should be merciful, and hast made thy children to be of a good hope that thou givest repentance for sins.
translations.ron: Prin lucruri ca acestea ai învăţat pe poporul Tău că cel drept trebuie să fie iubitor de oameni şi ai dat fiilor Tăi bună nădejde, că le laşi timp să se pocăiască de păcate.
translations.grk: Ἐδίδαξας δέ σου τὸν λαὸν διὰ τῶν τοιούτων ἔργων, ὅτι δεῖ τὸν δίκαιον εἶναι φιλάνθρωπον· καὶ εὐέλπιδας ἐποίησας τοὺς υἱούς σου, ὅτι δίδως ἑπὶ ἁμαρτήμασι μετάνοιαν.

verses.geez: ወሀበኒ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ፀረ፡ ደቂቅከ፡ እልክቱ፡ እለ፡ ድልዋን፡ ለመዊት፡ ምስለ፡ መጠነዝ፡ ትዕግሥት፡ ኰነንከ፡ ወወሀብኮሙ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ወፍኖተ፡ ከመ፡ ይድኀኑ፡ ባቲ፡ እምእኩይ።
verses.translation: For if thou didst punish the enemies of thy children, and the condemned to death, with such deliberation, giving them time and place whereby they might be delivered from their malice:

translations.lxx: For if thou didst punish the enemies of thy children, and the condemned to death, with such deliberation, giving them time and place whereby they might be delivered from their malice:
translations.ron: Că de vreme ce ai pedepsit cu atâta încetineală şi îngăduinţă pe duşmanii slujitorilor Tăi, deşi erau vinovaţi până la moarte, dându-le timp şi loc să se abată de la nelegiuirea lor,
translations.grk: Εἰ γὰρ ἐχθροὺς παίδων σου καὶ ὀφειλομένους θανάτῳ μετὰ τοσαύτης ἐτιμώρησας προσοχῆς καὶ δεήσεως, δοὺς χρόνους καὶ τόπον διʼ ὧν ἀπαλλαγῶσι τῆς κακίας·

verses.geez: ወሚመጠነ፡ በጥንቃቄ፡ ትኴንን፡ ውሉደከ፡ እለ፡ ወሀብኮሙ፡ መሐላ፡ ወኪዳነ፡ ተስፋ፡ ወእንዘ፡ ትጌሥፅ፡ ኪዳነ።
verses.translation: with how great circumspection didst thou judge thine own sons, unto whose fathers thou hast sworn, and made covenants of good promises?

translations.lxx: with how great circumspection didst thou judge thine own sons, unto whose fathers thou hast sworn, and made covenants of good promises?
translations.ron: Atunci cu câtă luare aminte judeci Tu pe robii Tăi, ai căror părinţi au primit de la Tine jurăminte şi legămintele unor strălucite făgăduinţe!
translations.grk: μετὰ πόσης ἀκριβείας ἔκρινας τοὺς υἱούς σου ὧν τοῖς πατράσιν ὅρκους καὶ συνθήκας ἔδωκας ἀγαθῶν ὑποσχέσεων;

verses.geez: ወጸረነሂ፡ በብዙኅ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ምእልፊተ፡ ትቀሥፍ፡ ከመ፡ ሶበ፡ ትኴንኖሙ፡ ኂሩተከ፡ ንዘከር፡ ወንትመሰሎ።
verses.translation: Therefore, whereas thou dost chasten us, thou scourgest our enemies a thousand times more, to the intent that, when we judge, we should carefully think of thy goodness, and when we ourselves are judged, we should look for mercy.

translations.lxx: Therefore, whereas thou dost chasten us, thou scourgest our enemies a thousand times more, to the intent that, when we judge, we should carefully think of thy goodness, and when we ourselves are judged, we should look for mercy.
translations.ron: Deci când ne mustri, Tu baţi pe vrăjmaşii noştri de mii de ori mai mult, ca să ţinem în seamă bunătatea Ta, când judecăm; iar când suntem judecaţi, să nădăjduim în îndurarea Ta.
translations.grk: Ἡμᾶς οὖν παιδεύων, τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ἡμῶν ἐν μυριότητι μαστιγοῖς, ἵνα σου τὴν ἀγαθότητα μεριμνῶμεν κρίνοντες, κρινόμενοι δὲ προσδοκῶμει ἔλεος.

verses.geez: ወሶበሂ፡ ንትኴነን፡ ንሴፎ፡ ሣህለከ፡ ወበዝየሰ፡ ኰነንከ፡ ዓማፅያነ፡ እለ፡ በዕደው፡ ሐይዉ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ወነበሩ፡ በኃጢአት።
verses.translation: Wherefore, whereas men have lived dissolutely and unrighteously, thou hast tormented them with their own abominations.

translations.lxx: Wherefore, whereas men have lived dissolutely and unrighteously, thou hast tormented them with their own abominations.
translations.ron: Drept aceea, pe cei nedrepţi care şi-au trăit viaţa nebuneşte, i-ai pedepsit cu înseşi faptele lor urâcioase.
translations.grk: Ὅθεν καὶ τοὺς ἐν ἀφροσύνῃ ζωῆς βιώσαντας ἀδίκους, διὰ τῶν ἰδίων ἐβασάνισας βδελυγμάτων.

verses.geez: ወኰነንኮሙ፡ በዘዚአሆሙ፡ ርኵሰ፡ እስመ፡ ተኀጒሉ፡ በነዋኅ፡ ፎኖተ፡ ስሕተት፡ አማልክተ፡ እንዘ፡ ይበሉ፡ ኅሡራነ፡ እንስሳ፡ ዘበኀበ፡ አንፃሪሆሙ።
verses.translation: For they went astray very far in the ways of error, and held them for gods, which even among the beasts of their enemies were despised, being deceived, as children of no understanding.

translations.lxx: For they went astray very far in the ways of error, and held them for gods, which even among the beasts of their enemies were despised, being deceived, as children of no understanding.
translations.ron: Căci au mers atât de departe pe căile rătăcirii, încât socoteau drept dumnezei dobitoacele cele mai respingătoare, înşelându-se ca pruncii cei fără de înţelepciune.
translations.grk: Καὶ γὰρ τῶν πλάνης ὁδῶν μακρότερον ἐπλανήθησαν, θεοὺς ὑπολαμβάνοντες τὰ καὶ ἐν ζώοις τῶν ἐχθρῶν ἄτιμα, νηπίων δίκην ἀφρόνων ψευσθέντες.

verses.geez: ወሐሰዉ፡ ከመ፡ ከቂቅ፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ አእምሮ፡ በእንተዝ፡ ከመ፡ ሕፃናት፡ እለ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ንባበ፡ ፈኖከ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ዘከመ፡ ተውኔቶሙ።
verses.translation: Therefore unto them, as to children without the use of reason, thou didst send a judgment to mock them.

translations.lxx: Therefore unto them, as to children without the use of reason, thou didst send a judgment to mock them.
translations.ron: Pentru aceea, ca unor prunci fără de minte le-ai trimis o pedeapsă de râs.
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο ὡς παισὶν ἀλογίστοις τὴν κρίσιν εἰς ἐμπαιγμὸν ἔπεμψας.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ተገሠፁ፡ ተግሣፀ፡ መዓት፡ ይጥዓሙኬ፡ ኅብስተ፡ ኵነኔሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሄር፡ ጻድቅ፡ እስመ፡ እሙንቱ፡ አንጐርጐሩ፡ በዘረከቦሙ፡ ሕማም፡ ወተአንተሉ።
verses.translation: But they that would not be reformed by that correction, wherein he dallied with them, shall feel a judgment worthy of God.

translations.lxx: But they that would not be reformed by that correction, wherein he dallied with them, shall feel a judgment worthy of God.
translations.ron: Iar cei care nu s-au pătruns de această certare neînsemnată vor simţi o pedeapsă vrednică de Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ παιγνίοις ἐπιτιμήσεως μὴ νουθετηθέντες, ἀξίαν Θεοῦ κρίσιν πειράσουσιν.

verses.geez: ወበእልክቱ፡ እለ፡ ሐላይዎሙ፡ አማልክተ፡ ሶበ፡ ተኰነኑቦሙ፡ የአምርዎ፡ ለዘክሕድዎ፡ ቀድሙ፡ ወየአምርዎ፡ ከመ፡ ውእቱ፡ አምላክ፡ ዘበጽድቅ፡ ወበእንተዝ፡ በጽሖሙ፡ ፍጻሜሁ፡ ለበቀል።
verses.translation: For, look, for what things they grudged, when they were punished, that is, for them whom they thought to be gods; [now] being punished in them, when they saw it, they acknowledged him to be the true God, whom before they denied to know; and therefore came extreme damnation upon them.

translations.lxx: For, look, for what things they grudged, when they were punished, that is, for them whom they thought to be gods; [now] being punished in them, when they saw it, they acknowledged him to be the true God, whom before they denied to know; and therefore came extreme damnation upon them.
translations.ron: Suferind şi tulburându-se cu ceea ce ei socoteau a fi dumnezei, au cunoscut pe Dumnezeul cel adevărat, pe Care altădată au zis că nu-L cunosc; pentru aceea, osânda cea mai de pe urmă a venit asupra lor.
translations.grk: Ἐφʼ οἷς γὰρ αὐτοὶ πάσχοντες ἠγανάκτουν, ἐπὶ τούτοις οὓς ἐδόκουν θεοὺς, ἐν αὐτοῖς κολαζόμενοι, ἰδόντες ὃν πάλαι ἠρνοῦντο εἰδέναι, Θεὸν ἐπέγνωσαν ἀληθῆ· διὸ καὶ τὸ τέρμα τῆς καταδίκης ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ἐπῆλθε.
